Fueling Deicing

Kraftstofftank-Betreten

The procedure of authorized personnel physically entering an aircraft fuel tank for inspection, cleaning, or maintenance, subject to strict safety controls.

Quick answer: The procedure of authorized personnel physically entering an aircraft fuel tank for inspection, cleaning, or maintenance, subject to strict safety controls.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Kraftstofftank-Betreten?

In this glossary, Kraftstofftank-Betreten refers to: The procedure of authorized personnel physically entering an aircraft fuel tank for inspection, cleaning, or maintenance, subject to strict safety controls.

How is Kraftstofftank-Betreten used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Personal muss vor Betreten des Kraftstofftanks zu Wartungszwecken eine Genehmigung einholen."

Kraftstofftank-Betreten matters because it supports clear communication in Fueling Deicing contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

The procedure of authorized personnel physically entering an aircraft fuel tank for inspection, cleaning, or maintenance, subject to strict safety controls.

Operational example

Personnel must obtain authorization before performing any fuel tank entry for maintenance purposes.
